subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Coleridge lost his father when he was only nine. He was very fond of reading and read a lot of books. He was sent to Cambridge and remained there for three years, but unfortunately he had to leave the Cambridge without having any degree. He had a great contribution in English Literature. He wrote a number of poems which brought for him a great fame. He was a literary critic and philosopher. He was a founder member of the Romantic Movement. But this great poet passed away in 1834.
